Name: Tile Marker
Author: NatrollEXE
Description:
[size=4][b]Tile Marker[/b][/size]

[b]Tile Marker[/b] is a small tool that allows players to select and save map tiles visually instead of finding coordinates and editing configuration files by hand.
I originally created it for [b]Lots of Kisses[/b], where it can mark counters, tables, chairs, decorations, and other places that shouldn’t prevent an NPC from seeing and reacting to a kiss.
However, Tile Marker isn’t limited to visibility checks. Other mod authors can use it for different purposes.

[b]Tile Marker doesn’t do anything by itself.[/b]
Another mod must support Tile Marker and register something for the player to select. If no compatible mod has registered a category, there will be nothing to mark.
[heading]Features[/heading]
[list]
[*]Select individual tiles directly inside the game.[/*]
[*]Paint or erase multiple tiles by dragging.[/*]
[*]Select rectangular areas.[/*]
[*]Saved selections are separated by save file, location, mod, and category.[/*]
[*]Supports touchscreen dragging for Cinderbox through an optional setting.[/*]
[*]Designed as a reusable framework for different mods and purposes.[/*]
[*]Generic Mod Config Menu support for convenient in-game settings.[/*]
[/list][heading]Compatibility[/heading]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.0.0+[/*]
[*]Tested on PC and Android through Cinderbox.[/*]
[*]Compatible with vanilla and custom map locations.[/*]
[*]Works with any mod that integrates the Tile Marker API.[/*]
[*]Multiplayer editing is host-only. [/*]
[*]Generic Mod Config Menu is optional.[/*]
[/list][heading]Installation[/heading]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Download and unzip Tile Marker into your
[code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code]folder.[/*]
[*]Install a mod that supports Tile Marker.[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list][heading]Documentation and Source Code[/heading]
For the integration tutorial, API documentation, controls, and additional information:
[list]
[*][color=#c27ba0][b][url=https://github.com/SheilaEXE/TileMarker#readme]Documentation and integration guide[/url][/b][/color][/*]
[*][color=#c27ba0][url=https://github.com/SheilaEXE/TileMarker][b]Source Code[/b][/url][/color][/*]
[/list]
